toUnit.description:
Destination Unit of the converter, i.e., the Unit this converter converts to.
For example, for Celsius -> Fahrenheit conversion, that would be Fahrenheit.

conversionExpr.description:
Expression that defines the custom unit transformation logic from the source unit of this edge to the unit pointed
to by this edge (destination node, i.e., to CustomUnitConvertor#toUnit). When evaluated it will return the value
measured in the destination unit.

Usage:
Within the expression, by convention, the source unit is represented by the dollar ($) sign. For example, the
Celsius -> Fahrenheit conversion expression can be represented as:
"1.8 * $ + 32"

title:
Custom conversion edge in the unit graph.
Such converter includes custom unit transformation logic in the form of expressions.
name: CustomUnitConvertor
